assumptions: New cases are assigned on insert; today assign() only runs on before update (CaseTriggerHandler.cls:16).

decisions.text: Where the round-robin position is stored so it survives between transactions: a custom setting, custom metadata or a field.

components.why: Must assign newly created cases, which it does not do today. It is the seed.
Needs cases that assert even distribution across agents. It tests CaseAssignmentService directly.
Calls assign() on before update only, so new cases need a before insert call. Shared with DEMO-201.
Needs an insert case that proves assignment runs from the trigger path. It exercises the handler contexts.
Subscribes to before and after update only, so it must also subscribe to before insert. Reached through CaseTriggerHandler.
Is the escalation queue the right pool for new cases? CaseAssignmentService uses it as the agent pool (CaseAssignmentService.cls:13 and :47-51); the index holds no edge to it.
